page.overview:
Who is Farouz?

Farouz was an acolyte training with the Sisterhood to become a Truthsayer.

Farouz was with Theodosia and Emeline when Imperial Guards entered, startling them. Farouz realized they were there for the princess, to arrange her accommodations while she trained with the Sisterhood. She hoped that Constantine Corrino would spend more time there once Ynez was there and would take a liking to Farouz.
